name: Log Work on Jira Issue
description: Logs time spent (a worklog) on a Jira issue. Use to log work, add a worklog, or record time spent.
author: anything-jira

input.hint: Base URL of your Jira Server / Data Center instance.
Jira Data Center Personal Access Token. Sent as a Bearer token. Stored locally in this skill's plugin.json.

issueKey.description: The Jira issue key, e.g. 'ENG-123'. Required.

timeSpent.description: Time spent in Jira format, e.g. '1h 30m', '2d', '45m'. Required.

comment.description: Optional worklog comment describing the work.
